description: List catalogue lines with the price in force today, filtered by code prefix, by currency and by tier. A SKU with no price in that currency and tier is listed and said to have none. Free.

currency.description: The currency the price in force is shown in. Defaults to the profile's

date.description: Show the price in force on this day instead of today, YYYY-MM-DD

limit.description: Maximum rows returned, default and ceiling 500

prefix.description: Only codes starting with this, e.g. HOST- for every hosting line

name: sku_list
title: List the catalogue
